ROW.COLUMN: (ML/CB) Unknown Remitter/Beneficiary Names in Checks, Monetary Instruments

This scenario identifies possible money laundering or fraud involving checks or monetary instruments with recurring remitters, beneficiaries, or both. This activity could be evidence of attempts to structure deposits and move funds back and forth between accounts in an effort to hide their origin. The scenario detects riskier remittances through correspondent (client bank) accounts involving significant percentages of unknown parties.

The scenario monitors activities between a pair of two unknown party roles for monetary instrument transaction. It groups data on the dataset level of the Primary Rule by the focal entity.
All scenario conditions are checked in the Primary Rule dataset. The Sub Rule followed by the Checkpoint use only to apply Max Transaction Count condition.
Only one match for the giving focal entity can be generated.
